## Problem and existing issue

Describe the reproducible problem, link the issue if applicable, and confirm this PR does not duplicate an active fix.

## Implementation and compatibility

Explain the before/after behavior, minimal code change, compatibility, security and privacy implications.

## Verification

- [ ] Ran Python unit tests from the repository root (or documented why not)
- [ ] Ran the release verifier if hash-tracked sources changed
- [ ] Updated SHA256SUMS for modified allowlisted files, if applicable
- [ ] Ran git diff --check
- [ ] Reviewed the diff for secrets, personal data and generated files
- [ ] Checked overlapping open PRs

Provide **actual commands and outcomes**. Do not report hosted CI as passing when only local tests were run.

## Limitations and AI assistance

Describe remaining limitations, trade-offs and any AI assistance with human verification.

## Reviewer focus

What behaviors or edge cases deserve particular review?
